datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Mauritania in 2012, classifying geographic areas into food insecurity phases based on standardized assessment criteria. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions across multiple scenarios and time periods.
